headline: Data Engineer | Data Pipelines and Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Highly motivated Data Engineer with 6 years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining robust data pipelines. Proven ability to work collaboratively in agile environments and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines. Passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technologies to optimize data workflows and drive data-driven decision making.

bullets: Designed and implemented a new data pipeline using dbt and Snowflake, resulting in a 20% reduction in data processing time.
Developed and automated data quality checks using Airflow, ensuring 99.9% data accuracy.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate data from multiple sources, streamlining reporting and analysis processes.
Mentored junior data engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Built and maintained ETL processes using Python and SQL, processing over 500 million data records per day.
Developed and deployed data visualizations using Tableau, providing actionable insights to stakeholders.
Streamlined data ingestion processes, reducing latency by 30% and improving data availability.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Interaction Design
